chunks: And Abu Ja'far Muhammad ibn Ali ibn al-Husayn ibn Babawayh (may Allah have mercy on him) said:
And in another narration, the slave may marry two free women, or four female slaves, or two female slaves and one free woman.
ai.seo_question: How many wives can a male slave have in Shia Islamic law?
ai.summary: This narration from al-Ishtibār details the specific marital capacities of a male slave (ʿabd), reflecting the juristic debate on whether his status limits him to female slaves or permits marriage to free women. The variants highlight the flexibility in Shia fiqh regarding the combination of free and enslaved women, underscoring the legal distinction between the slave’s partial autonomy and that of a free man. This ruling is crucial for understanding the social and legal dynamics of slavery within the Shia jurisprudential framework.
